chunks: Verily God will admit those who believe and do the right into gardens with streams of water running by. But the unbelievers revel and carouse and subsist like beasts, and Hell will be their residence.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the reward for believers and the punishment for disbelievers in this verse?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Muhammad highlights the dichotomy between the eternal bliss of the faithful and the transient, animalistic enjoyment of the disbelievers, a theme central to Shia exegetical discussions on the nature of worldly pleasure (ta'ammul) versus spiritual permanence. The comparison to grazing animals underscores the superficiality of the disbelievers' satisfaction, which ultimately leads to the Fire as their final abode.
